verdict.rationale: Cua's own docs show user-controlled deletion in two places: vault items can be locked or deleted, and the uninstall command keeps Spaces and their data unless the user asks for them to be removed. Neither amounts to a configurable retention policy. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or policies, deletion controls for the persistent Cua Volume and agent memory, account-level data deletion, independent corroboration.
